name: dj-midi-watts-web-ui
description: Web UI assets for DJ MIDI WATTS

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist'); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', 'dist/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('styles.css', 'dist/styles.css'); fs.copyFileSync('script.js', 'dist/script.js');"
